name: Palazzo Saluzzo di Paesana Torino Italy 1722
summary: Immerse yourself in the historical magnificence of Turin with the Meta Quest app that lets you explore Palazzo Saluzzo di Paesana like never before. Thanks to advanced photogrammetry, you can virtually visit every corner of this extraordinary noble palace, built between 1715 and 1722 by Gian Giacomo Plantery for the Marquis Baldassarre Saluzzo di Paesana. The app, currently in beta, offers a multiplayer mode that allows you to connect with friends and other history enthusiasts for a shared virtual visit. Ex
